notes.title: Announcement: Saku the Covert Agent Official Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015356/070f32fe2576bc46d911bbf44310ae8429309377.jpg[/img]

Following the previous update that added side quests, we've further optimized certain sound effects and puzzle loading performance. With this, the content for version 1.0 is now complete. As planned, the game will officially leave Early Access and be fully released today.

However, we will continue to update and expand the game's content moving forward.
 In the future, we plan to introduce two new heroines—Lucy and Eve—along with their exclusive story routes and puzzle stages.
These new main storylines will take place after Saku’s route and will be on par with the original Saku route in terms of scale and depth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015356/9d49e05d12e18441002b3297b461ea582b417078.png[/img]

Please stay tuned for upcoming news and future updates!
